de: German tennis player Alexander Zverev will become the new leader of the ATP rating, beating Italian Yannick Sinner - this will happen at the end of the tournament in Vienna.

te: Ghalibaf: Progress in dialogue with US is possible only after Iran accepts conditions
de: Progress in the dialogue with Washington will be possible only on one condition – if the United States agrees to all seven of Iran’s demands.
